_meta.source: Idris 02: German v2 (Elias->Ilyas, Nuh->Noah; 'voller Liebe und Freude' and 'darum' removed, H55). Complete verses quoted: Maryam 19:56, 19:57. Hadith: Bukhari 3207 / Muslim 162 (Idris in the 4th heaven, 'welcome, righteous brother and righteous prophet').

s01: Shhh… Noah, Ilyas… do you know which prophet of Allah was raised very, very high? Up to a wonderful place. Tonight I will tell you. Come, snuggle in.
s02: Yesterday we heard about the Prophet Adam. And tonight I will tell you about the Prophet Idris, peace be upon him.
s03: Grandma, Grandma, was Idris a strong hero?
s04: My little Ilyas, Idris was something much better than that. Listen carefully.
s05: In the Qur’an Allah says about him: “And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.”
s06: That means Idris always told the truth. Always. And he was a prophet who told people about Allah.
s07: Allah also says that Idris was one of the patient.
s08: Do you know what patience means? It means not giving up, even when something takes long or is hard. Idris was patient.
s09: And Allah says that he was one of the righteous, and that He admitted him into His mercy.
s10: And then Allah says something very special: “And We raised him to a high station.” A high place.
s11: Grandma, how high? Higher than the clouds?
s13: Our Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, told us: in the wondrous night when he travelled up through the heavens, he met the Prophet Idris in the fourth heaven.
s14: And do you know what Idris said to him? He said: Welcome to the righteous brother and the righteous prophet.
s15: Imagine that: two prophets greeting each other in heaven.
s16: We do not know very much about the Prophet Idris. But what Allah tells us about him is enough for us to love him.
s17: He was truthful. He was patient. He was good. And Allah raised him to a high place.
s18: Noah? Ilyas? They are already asleep.
s19: Sleep well, my little stars, and remember: always tell the truth and be patient, for Allah loves the patient.
s20: Tomorrow I will tell you about the Prophet Noah and a huge, huge ship. Good night.
